items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I never did play with him, but I knew him real well.

ctx.x: We used to call him Red Allen, the young fella.
I never did play with him, but I knew him real well. And I knew his father too, see. I played several times with his father in the brass band. He had a brass band. That's right. Uh huh.
Let me see. What about Mercedes Fields? Who? Mercedes Fields? Fills?
